"Outputs a signal [1-6]. 1 for sunny, 2 for cloudy, 3 for rain, 4 for thunderstorm, 5 for aurora borealis, 6 for star rain"

The Weather Sensor is a logic component that can be purchased from Alan's AutoLogistics for $700. It outputs a signal of 1-6 depending on the current weather it senses.

The Weather Sensor is near identical to the Daylight Sensor, the main feature being the eyeball. The only differentiating part of the Weather Sensor is the color of the eye's iris.

Functionality

When placed, the Weather Sensor outputs a value of 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, or 6 depending on the current weather.

  • 1 being Sunny/Clear.
  • 2 being Cloudy.
  • 3 being Rainy.
  • 4 being a Thunderstorm.
  • 5 being Aurora Borealis (Northern Lights)
  • 6 being Star Rain

The weather sensor allows the user interact with structures such as the Electronic Billboard or 14 Segment Display, using wires. When connected to these structures, the output number (1, 2 , 3 4, 5, or 6) will be shown on the display.

The Weather Sensor is an output logic system only. It has no input connection.
